samples.question: Both halves of this picture draw the same network: the same nine dots and the same thirteen links between them, but the dots are placed differently in the two halves, so position on the page tells you nothing and only the pattern of links matches. One dot on the left is inside a black ring. That same dot appears on the right, and exactly one of the four coloured dots on the right is it. Which colour is it? Answer with exactly one of: red, blue, green, orange.
